name: Taparita
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Extinct, poorly attested (Rosenblat 1936 wordlist material only); no stress description exists

sources.citation: Real Biblioteca Digital catalogue record for MS II/2927 (rbdigital.realbiblioteca.es item 15310): creator Lucena, Geronimo Jose de; date s. XVIII (1788); languages Espanol, Otomaco, Taparita, Yarura; contributor Buenaventura de Benaocaz.
Wikipedia (en) 'Otomakoan languages', Wikipedia (es) 'Lenguas otomaco-taparita', Wiktionary 'Appendix:Otomacoan word lists' (data from Rosenblat 1936).
sources.note: Nothing on phonology or stress; cite only Rosenblat 1936, Campbell 2012, Loukotka 1968.

sources.citation: [Real Biblioteca]. 1928. Lenguas de America: manuscritos de la Real Biblioteca, tomo I (Catalogo de la Real Biblioteca, t. VI). Madrid: Graficas Reunidas. archive.org id lenguasdeamerica01spai.
sources.note: Irrelevant after inspection: tomo I prints only the Achagua, Andaqui, Aruaca, Caribe, Ceona, Guama, Guarani and Guarauno MSS; the Otomaca/Taparita/Yarura MS II/2927 is not included (checked the Indice). Nothing on Taparita.

sources.citation: Lucena (Luzena), Fr. Geronimo Jose de. 1788. Traducion de la lengua espanola a la otomaca; Traducion de la lenga esp.la en la taparita; [Yarura]. Madrid, Real Biblioteca, MS II/2927 ([2]+9+[3] ff.). Digitized: Real Biblioteca Digital item 15310, IIIF manifest.
sources.note: Nothing. Taparita part (ff.4r-6v, images 0008-0011) is a bare two-column Spanish-Taparita wordlist (~450 entries) with sporadic grave accents mostly on final vowels (e.g. Yocà 'tu', Nacapaì 'ser', Yaoparà 'lumbre', Guerotà 'leon', Dullollà 'aguila', Yungà 'lana') but many words unmarked; the closing 'Nota' (22 Nov 1788) only explains that Beguemi means 'que no sabe' (item unknown to the Indians). No prefatory matter (flyleaves blank), no remark on pronunciation or accent. Otomaco part's Nota (f.3r) likewise only glosses Yaya 'no se'.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid pages tapa1262 / otom1301 / family otom1276 and reference records 32305, 33233, 581647 (glottolog.org), incl. langdoc complexquery bibliographies.
sources.note: Bibliographic only: confirms the entire Taparita literature = Lucena MS + Rosenblat 1936/1964; family-level adds Adelaar & Muysken 2004, Loukotka 1968, Brinton 1891, Veigl 1785, Crevaux et al. 1882 (overviews/wordlists, Otomaco side). No stress information.
